item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces have intensified attacks on Ukrainian civilian infrastructure, striking a humanitarian hub, a hospital, a hospice and power plants, killing dozens and injuring many. Ukrainian drones are being used to evacuate wounded troops from the front, while Russia has deployed heavily-armed drones and launched its biggest mass attack on Ukraine's energy grid this year. The Oleshky ceasefire is being exploited by Russian troops to move forces, and a Russian Su‑57 fighter was lost to an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Nigeria: the situation
item.description:

Security operatives have rescued multiple victims, such as eight abducted residents in Kaduna, a pregnant woman and seven others in Kaduna, and a group of 37 worshippers held for 212 days in Kaduna. Bandits have killed vigilantes, including a 18‑year-old in Plateau and a young woman in Bauchi, and police officers in a Sokoto-Zamfara highway ambush. item.description:
